title: Desktop vitals grid opens with a clipped sliver beside the names: snap its left edge with Trend's width taken out of max
evidence: From D2 (the phone fade after H79). At 1440 in real WebKit, with 13 saved weights, the vitals grid opens at scrollLeft 678 of 678: Trend is sticky at the right (styles.css .bt-timeline-scroll .bt-cell-trend), New 818-900, Trend 900-954. The left-most visible date column sits partly under the sticky name column, so only its "ys / dia" tail shows. H79 snaps whole columns only where Trend scrolls (widget-src/src/lib/useValuePage.ts:85-95). Remedy: on desktop, snap the left edge to a whole column with the sticky Trend's width taken out of max, so New stays clear of Trend. (H102)
